messages:
kyra (support): Hey team — incoming customer escalation. Trial org `org_01X-redacted` says they made a series of API calls yesterday (~2026-08-15 21:03 UTC) that returned successfully but their trial credit never decreased. Customer sent logs + request IDs. Filing here for triage.

samir (billing): Can you paste the ledger_id / billing account id and one request_id? I'll check debits.

kyra (support): Ledger id: `ledger_tr_0a9b`, billing account: `acct_TRIAL_394`. One request id from their log: `req_20260815_9f2b3a`. They ran a few streaming completions and an embeddings batch (\~3.2M tokens reported on client). Customer claims UI still shows full trial credits.

alex (eng): Quick sanity: did the client do any retries with different idempotency keys? If requests were retried without idempotency it could double-charge — but this is opposite. Could be a missing debit event downstream. Also need the full request headers (x-request-id / authorization truncated).

customer_acct_rep: Here's the curl they used, redacted keys:
```
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk.trial.redacted" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-alpha-2b","input":"Summarize customer logs...","max_tokens":800,"stream":true}'
```
They said they let the stream finish and got a 200 with final token count in the client: `tokens_used: 421234`.

maria (infra): I ran a quick query against the events table for `req_20260815_9f2b3a` and the surrounding window. No debit event recorded for that request_id and no matching billing_event. The request did hit the runtime (trace shows completion).

billing-bot: Created billing investigation ticket `BILL-5921` for ledger `ledger_tr_0a9b` and linked support thread. SLA: 72h.

samir (billing): Noted. Two hypotheses: 1) post-processing pipeline that emits consumption events failed for trial ledgers only (rare), or 2) these were routed to a special 'metering-disabled' endpoint due to a config flag on the trial org. I'll check meter-service logs and config map for `acct_TRIAL_394`.

alex (eng): Can you dump the runtime trace ID and KV cache correlation? If the runtime emitted usage but the metering service failed to ack, we should see an outbox retry or DLQ entry. Also share `x-server-trace` header if present.

kyra (support): Customer provided additional IDs: runtime_trace=`rt_1c7e`, x-server-trace header=`trace-9f2b3a`. They said they retried once after a transient 502 and the second attempt returned 200.

samir (billing): Aha — if they retried, maybe idempotency header was omitted and the retry path used our soft-fail that suppresses meter emissions for perceived duplicates. But that behavior should still produce debits. I'll check code paths.

maria (infra): I pulled meter-service logs for 2026-08-15 21:00-21:30 UTC. I see a downstream Kafka partition leader swap around 21:07 and a small window where the meter ingestion consumer lag spiked. There are some `MessageProcessed` entries missing for `ledger_tr_0a9b`.

alex (eng): If meter ingestion failed during leader swap, messages should have remained in topic and been reprocessed. If those messages were acked prematurely by a buggy consumer, they could be lost. I don't see a consumer group reset in the normal logs but will grep deeper.

customer_acct_rep: Customer is worried — they used the trial to run an eval job and now show full credits; they want either the charges applied retroactively or credits restored so their evaluation can continue.

jen (support-manager): Approve immediate provisional credit grant up to reported usage while investigation is ongoing. Please add a note: provisional grant to `acct_TRIAL_394` of 3.3M tokens equivalent, tag `provisional-billing-20260815`, and mark as reversible if we find the ledger shows actual debits. @samir please confirm.

samir (billing): I approve provisional grant. I'll also run a ledger reconciliation job for `ledger_tr_0a9b` across raw ingestion and billing aggregates. If we confirm missing debits, we'll either apply actual debits (if possible to retro-emit) or reconcile via chargeback.

ops-lisa: Adding ops: I'll open a postmortem stub for `meter-ingest-kafka-leader-swap-20260815`. Assign infra + billing + eng. Need timeline, root cause, and remediation (ensure at-least-once processing with idempotent writes).

alex (eng): Quick next steps for eng: 1) grep consumer acks around `rt_1c7e` and `trace-9f2b3a` 2) check DLQ for any messages for `ledger_tr_0a9b` 3) reproduce locally: simulate leader swap and see if meter-client ack races. I'll update by EOD UTC.

maria (infra): I'll capture broker logs and consumer offsets and snapshot the topic for forensic analysis. Also raising an alert rule to detect consumer-ack anomalies.

kyra (support): Communicated provisional credit to customer and ETA ~24h for initial findings. They replied :relieved: and asked for an entry explaining how to avoid (they retried on 502 without idempotency header). I suggested they always set `Idempotency-Key` header for retries — shared link to docs.

samir (billing): Status update (1766304550): Reconciliation job found that 17 ingestion events for `ledger_tr_0a9b` were marked processed by consumer group `meter-ingest-v2` but there is no write to the billing table for those messages. Looks like a consumer callback error: processed -> acked, but final persistence failed and we didn't NACK. Investigating root cause in consumer code.

alex (eng): I found an exception in the meter consumer around the same time: `NullPointer` when composing the billing row if `usage_meta` is empty. Error handling path swallowed and acked. Fix: ensure we validate fields and requeue on persistence failure. I'll open a PR for the fix and add a retry wrapper.

jen (support-manager): Great. Once patch is landed, schedule a backfill to re-emit the missing 17 events into the billing write pipeline so charges apply. For now leave provisional credit in place; create a final reconciliation note before reversing anything.

billing-bot: Updated ticket `BILL-5921`: investigation in progress, provisional grant applied, eng fix PR `meter-consumer/392` opened, ops PM assigned.

kyra (support): Final customer message queued: "Thanks — provisional credits received. Please advise if any reversals are needed; we'll pause the large eval run until you confirm." I'll keep the thread updated. :white_check_mark:

samir (billing): Follow-up action items (list): ["merge PR meter-consumer/392", "reprocess missing ingestion events for ledger_tr_0a9b", "run full ledger reconciliation for trial orgs 21:00-21:15 UTC", "confirm with customer before reversing provisional credits"]. Assigning to eng + infra + billing.

alex (eng): I'll aim to get PR out in next 3 hours and coordinate backfill after ops snapshot is taken.

maria (infra): Snapshot taken and isolated topic copy stored at `s3://redwood-forensics/meterings/2026-08-15-21-07`. Backfill plan in `BILL-5921`.

kyra (support): Closing loop for now — provisional credits applied, investigation underway, eng fix and backfill planned. Will reopen thread with final reconciliation notes.

customer_acct_rep: Thanks team — appreciated quick response.
